हमारी भाषा हमारी लिपी ! आमची मराठी आमची लिपी !

Type 100% faster using touch gestures
जेश्चर टाईपिंग से १०० % जल्द टाइपिंग
जेश्चर वापरून मात्रा काढा, पटापट लिहा

आप की सारी जानकारी सुरक्षित हैं, हम क़ुछ भी (क्रेडिट कार्ड वा पासवर्ड) स्टोर नहीं करते. 

We do NOT read/store your personal information, like credit card or passwords (Google warning is generic, it does NOT reflect on Lipee Devanagari Keyboard.)

Use smileys, Devnagari numbers and switch between Hindi / Marathi / English at ease!

Lipee keyboard currently supports Hindi and Marathi. Other languages with Indic scripts, such as Kannada / Bengali / Gujarati are under development.


Demo to use Lipee Keyboard - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UgW9V4YOHGQ

It's Different --- How Lipee Leaves Competition Biting Dust!  - https://youtu.be/MhFUwddJwL4

========================================

नमस्कार दोस्तों, सारे हिंदी भाषिकोंको "स्वयु" की तरफ से आपको शुभकामनाएं ! 

क्या आप अपने दोस्तों को और रिश्तेदारोंको हमेशा संदेश भेजते है- जैसे के Whatsapp, चुटकुले, मनभावन विचार, यादें, खबरें  या समाचार इत्यादि?  

पर English किबोर्ड से नफ़रत है? हिंदी लिखने के लिए English किबोर्ड क्यूँ सीखना है? तो उसे पर्याय क्या हैं?

"स्वयु IT" की तरफ से हम  लेके आये हैं हमारा नया "लिपी किबोर्ड", जो आप मुफ़त  डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं। यह कीबोर्ड आपकी भाषा समझेगा और आपको अपनी मन की बात 100% जल्द भेजने में मदद करेगा।

========================================


Friends!

Would you not love to connect with your dear ones using Hindi? How about sharing jokes, stories and news? Won't it be awesome if the Devnagari keyboards were simple and easy to use! We are pleased to bring Lipee Keyboard for you, fast Hindi Keyboard and no ads! It's simple, intuitive and safe.

Built with Indian technology, Lipee Keyboard is very different from other keyboard apps, you can type using this keyboard very similar to how you write Hindi by hand. 

Easy Installation and set up : 

- Download the app and open it.
- Enable Lipee Hindi Keyboard in Step 1 and choose it in Step 2.
- That's all! You can type Hindi everywhere now.
- To change keyboard language,open app and choose हिंदी / मराठी 

Find your familiar characters in Devnagari layout. You simply have to press on any character (such as 'क' ) and make unique gestures to create 'का', 'कि ','कु', etc. As you start writing you will find auto-suggest of Hindi words, you may want to choose one of the suggestions and move on to write the next word.

quotes.text:
We have a Android Keyboard, a working application. However, we know it needs more work and some more killer features. In that sense it's half-baked.

Lipee Keyboard ( https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=in.svayu.lipi ) is a keyboard for Indic scripts and languages that uses gestures to speed up typing by 100%. I am also my own prime user, typing various texts (messages, social media, etc.) in Indic scripts, so I can also vouch of its utility myself.

A video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UgW9V4YOHGQ

The first novelty is that it solely focuses on people who do NOT read/write English, but know their own mother tongue and script well. So, a native Kannada user (of Kannada script) or Bhojpuri person (of Devnagari script) are our prime targets.

The second novelty is that almost all Indic scripts add an extra line/symbol next to consonants, called "maatras" to create sound out of a consonant. Each sound has a unique maatra, for any consonant. We use gestures to add such a maatra to all consonants, which speeds up the keyboard typing hugely.

We know we can add more features and killer technologies to make typing in Indic scripts very smooth and fast.

We need more tech talent and support to make this happen, and I hope to on-board a CXO or a senior free-lancer for rapid development.

Do up-vote if you like this project, and spread the word!

Thanks!
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: Show me your half baked project
